reference.note: no published closed-model number exists for this set; the 3-class task is easier than the 5-class one by construction, so the two accuracies are not comparable as numbers

uncertainty.single_run: one pass at temperature 0; quantised local weights
uncertainty.view: post_field image only; the pre-event Mapillary counterpart is not shown to the model (Prompt C is single-image)
uncertainty.truth_source: dataset label_name (3-class repairability derived from CAL FIRE DINS by the matched set's protocol); the prompt's 5 DINS classes are collapsed onto it before scoring
uncertainty.minority_class: damaged_repairable has n=30 in the whole set; its recall is reported, no rate claim is supported from it
uncertainty.match_quality: samples admitted: good, usable; the dataset's own gate, recorded per record
uncertainty.claim_support: none — evaluation only; no policy rule authorises claims from these predictions
